units.title: Gentle Openings
units.description: Start with respectful greetings, wellness, names, and family words.

lessons.title: Greetings and Respect
lessons.summary: Say hello, thank you, sorry, please, and goodbye in gentle spoken Malayalam.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Nanni mean?
Type the Malayalam for sorry.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Namaskaram -> hello / respectful greeting, Nanni -> thank you, Dayavaayi -> please, Shari -> okay

exercises.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

lessons.title: How Are You?
lessons.summary: Ask how someone is and answer with simple wellness phrases.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Sukham Aanu mean?
Type the Malayalam for I am not well.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Sukhamano? -> are you well?, Sukham Aanu -> I am well, Enikku Sukham Alla -> I am not well, Valare Nanni -> thank you very much

exercises.prompt: Complete the phrase for thank you very much.

lessons.title: Names and Introductions
lessons.summary: Say your name, ask someone else's name, and explain that you know a little Malayalam.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Ningalude Peru Enthaanu? mean?
Type the Malayalam for I did not understand.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Ente Peru Rachel Aanu -> my name is Rachel, Ningalude Peru Enthaanu? -> what is your name?, Enikku Malayalam Kurachu Ariyam -> I know a little Malayalam, Veendum Parayamo? -> can you say it again?

exercises.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

lessons.title: Family and People
lessons.summary: Learn warm family words you may hear in homes and conversations.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Achan mean?
Type the Malayalam for older sister.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Amma -> mother, Achan -> father, Chechi -> older sister, Chettan -> older brother

exercises.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

units.title: Home and Daily Life
units.description: Practice food, home visits, daily phrases, and simple questions.

lessons.title: Food and Drinks
lessons.summary: Ask for water, tea, rice, and simple food help.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Ith Nalla Aanu mean?
Type the Malayalam for I want tea.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Vellam Venam -> I want water, Choru Venam -> I want rice, Enikku Vishakkunnu -> I am hungry, Kurachu Mathi -> a little is enough

exercises.prompt: Complete: I want water.

lessons.title: Visiting Someone's Home
lessons.summary: Use friendly home-visit phrases for sitting, eating, and entering politely.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Kazhicho? mean?
Type the Malayalam for I ate.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Akathu Varatte? -> may I come inside?, Irikku -> sit, Kazhicho? -> did you eat?, Veedu Nalla Aanu -> the house is nice

exercises.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

lessons.title: Daily Conversation
lessons.summary: Use short everyday phrases for going, coming, waiting, and meeting again.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Ivide Va mean?
Type the Malayalam for see you tomorrow.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Njan Pokunnu -> I am going, Namukku Pokam -> let's go, Ivide Va -> come here, Ippo Venda -> not now

exercises.prompt: Complete: let's go.

lessons.title: Questions and Small Talk
lessons.summary: Ask the tiny questions that keep a conversation moving.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Ethra? mean?
Type the Malayalam for who?
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Evide? -> where?, Enthaanu? -> what is it?, Ethra? -> how much?, Eppol? -> when?

exercises.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

lessons.title: Travel and Getting Around
lessons.summary: Ask for the bathroom, taxi help, a price, and where to stop.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Njan Vazhi Thetti mean?
Type the Malayalam for I need a taxi.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Bathroom Evide Aanu? -> where is the bathroom?, Ivide Nirthu -> stop here, Ethra Aanu? -> how much is it?, Njan Vazhi Thetti -> I am lost

exercises.prompt: Complete: Stop here.

units.title: Requests, Feelings, and Help
units.description: Build confidence with polite requests, needs, emergencies, and mixed review.

lessons.title: Polite Requests
lessons.summary: Ask someone to repeat, slow down, give something, or wait a moment.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Veendum Parayamo? mean?
Type the Malayalam for one moment.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Dayavaayi Parayamo? -> please tell me, Kurachu Pathukke Parayamo? -> can you speak slowly?, Ithu Taramo? -> can you give this?, Oru Nimisham -> one moment

exercises.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

lessons.title: Feelings and Needs
lessons.summary: Say how you feel with simple, useful everyday phrases.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Enikku Ksheenam Aanu mean?
Type the Malayalam for I like it.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Enikku Santhosham Aanu -> I am happy, Enikku Ksheenam Aanu -> I am tired, Enikku Pedi Aanu -> I am scared, Enikku Urakkam Varunnu -> I am sleepy

exercises.prompt: Complete: I am not well.

lessons.title: Help and Emergencies
lessons.summary: Ask for help, a doctor, police, medicine, or help with a lost phone.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Marunnu Kada Evide Aanu? mean?
Type the Malayalam for please help me.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Enikku Sahayam Venam -> I need help, Doctor-e Vilikkamo? -> can you call a doctor?, Police-e Vilikkamo? -> can you call the police?, Ente Phone Nashtappettu -> I lost my phone

exercises.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

lessons.title: Review: Everyday Malayalam
lessons.summary: Review the most useful phrases for greeting, introducing yourself, eating, travel, and help.

exercises.prompt: Listen first. Then tap what you hear.
What does Enikku Vellam Venam mean?
Type the Malayalam for I need help.
Match Malayalam to English.
exercises.answer: Namaskaram -> hello / respectful greeting, Ningal Sukhamano? -> are you well?, Bathroom Evide Aanu? -> where is the bathroom?, Enikku Sahayam Venam -> I need help

exercises.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.
